title: Ben Arzah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned at the beginning of Shekalim, chapter 5, as the Temple official in charge of the cymbal; in the Tosefta there, chapter 2, halakhah 4, he is in charge of the platform—and it is the same thing.[^1]

notes.text: Mishnah Shekalim 5:1 names Ben Arza as responsible for the cymbal. The Mechon Mamre Tosefta Shekalim text returned here names Ben Arza as responsible for the platform at 2:14, rather than Hyman’s supplied 2:4. The locator and equation of the offices in the translation follow Hyman.
